archetypes.name: state-machine
archetypes.rationale: The diff changes /design's multi-round review controller, Gate B/Gate C routing, resume behavior, and cap semantics across prompt docs and shell helpers.
archetypes.prompt_body: Investigate the Step 3, Step 3.5, Gate B, and Gate C control flow as a state machine. Look for paths where automatic continuation, explicit approval, cap handling, pause/resume sentinels, or manual re-run can skip required steps, repeat an apply, or strand artifacts. Compare the prompt-side SKILL.md instructions with the shell helper contracts and docs changed in this diff. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: artifact-state
archetypes.rationale: The change introduces cumulative accepted-finding artifacts and retally merging that must integrate safely with existing per-round and manual re-entry artifacts.
archetypes.prompt_body: Investigate how accepted-plan-findings-all.md, accepted-plan-findings.md, oos-accepted-design.md, retally output, and .step3-review-result.env interact across automatic rounds, degraded paths, tally errors, main-agent-vote-required, and manual Gate C re-entry. Focus on stale data, double counting, rollback gaps, symlink or tmpdir assumptions, and mismatches between cumulative summary data and the current Gate B apply set. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: bash-portability
archetypes.rationale: The implementation is Bash-heavy and touches parsing/counting logic where subtle shell, awk, and Python interactions can break harnesses or macOS/runtime behavior.
archetypes.prompt_body: Investigate the new and modified shell helpers for Bash portability, quoting, numeric coercion, set -e behavior, array use, subprocess failure handling, and awk/Python parsing assumptions. Pay special attention to render-final-summary.sh counting logic, plan-review-continuation.sh stats extraction, persist-retally-step3-env.sh merging, and relevant-checks target routing. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
